tier_reason: Raised C to B: the enricher found an independent measurement in manticore-projects/FPNG-Java's README (JMH, JDK 21.0.1 GraalVM, SerialGC, CPU unstated) that runs pngencoder 0.14.0 single-threaded at compression level 2 against javax.imageio on the same looklet 4900x6000 image: 1120 ms versus 1270 ms (1.13x), with 1.29x, 1.44x and 1.36x on the other cases and 2.26-3.53x at level 1 (derived from page data). It confirms the verifier's reading that the README's 5.1-7.1x comes mostly from the 8-thread pool; the random 1024x1024 case is incompressible noise, where ImageIO's five-filter trial is pure overhead. Not A: CPU unstated.

corrections.claimed_speedup: Independent JMH run (manticore-projects/FPNG-Java README, JDK 21.0.1 GraalVM, SerialGC, CPU unstated), pngencoder 0.14.0 single-threaded vs javax.imageio: level 2 on a 4900x6000 image 1120 vs 1270 ms (1.13x), 1.29-1.44x on the other cases, 2.26-3.53x at level 1 (derived from page data). First-party README (multithreaded pool of availableProcessors threads): 5.1-7.1x over ImageIO.
